profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer @ RTX | C++, Java, ROS
profile.summary: I apply my skills in robotics software development and testing to create innovative solutions for autonomous systems. I have over 4 years of experience in developing ROS packages in C++ for various applications, including LiDAR to optical sensor calibration for FedEx's autonomous delivery vehicle. I also have expertise in migrating LiDAR-based perception packages from CUDA to SYCL after transitioning to Intel hardware. Additionally, I have developed ROS packages for precise plotting of collected sensor data in ROS's rviz tool. My passion for robotics and software engineering drives me to continuously learn new technologies and techniques to enhance the performance and reliability of autonomous systems.

positions.title: Robotics Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed ROS packages in C++ that enabled LiDAR to optical sensor calibration for FedEx's autonomous delivery vehicle. This calibration facilitates the vehicle’s ability to perceive its environment accurately, leading to better decisions based on that perception.
• Migrated LiDAR-based perception packages from CUDA to SYCL after transitioning to Intel hardware.
• Developed ROS package for highly precise plotting of collected sensor data in ROS's rviz tool.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed ROS packages in C++ that monitored data collection and mapping for FedEx's autonomous delivery vehicle. This data was essential for feeding ML models and testing new features.
• Developed unit and integration tests in C++ for safety critical subsystems.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Conducted software and manual tests for an in-home dialysis device and maintained the test results.
• Developed/Updated python test cases for software integration tests.

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Aided in qualifying a surface mount production line.
    - This included Pick and Place machines, solder dispenser, and a reflow oven.
• Created protocols related to FDA Regulations.
• Compiled and tested PCB functionality.

positions.title: R&D Thoracic Intern
positions.description:
• Executed projects that aided in the completion of FDA remediation.
    - Functionality Tests for blood bags, catheter, and express suction bulb. (Real Time/Accelerated Aging)
    - Qualifying mainly the Pneumostat Assembly production line located in a sterile environment production facility. This line includes Ultrasonic Welders, a Lubrication Dispenser, a Hydraulic Press, and Leak Tester.
    - Executed a high priority PSO for PVC Catheters to undergo Handling and Distribution Testing, as well as 2x EtO sterilization.
